Audrey’s Gastric Sleeve Before and After Transformation

[vc_row][vc_column][vc_column_text]✨ Meet Audrey ✨
Gastric Sleeve Surgery • June 2020
Total Lost: 83 lbs 💪

“At 253 lbs, I was battling high blood pressure, diabetes, high cholesterol—and sleeping with a CPAP machine every night. I felt trapped in a body that was holding me back.

Just 2 months after surgery with Dr. Curry at @JourneyLite, I was OFF all medications. 🙌

Surgery gave me the tool—but I did the work. This isn’t a diet. It’s a lifestyle.

Today, I can cross my legs, climb stairs without losing my breath, and truly enjoy life with my family and friends again.

Thank you, Dr. Curry and the JourneyLite team, for giving me a second chance at life.” 💖
